subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: What Control UI notification architecture and scope should OpenClaw own for cron completion actions, snooze/reschedule behavior, and context-pressure prompts?
rationale: Current main has partial building blocks, but the missing behavior changes user-facing notification policy and cron workflow semantics across multiple surfaces, so automation should not choose the product shape.

options.title: Scope focused core design
options.body: Define the generic UI notification queue, cron-finished integration, and snooze/reschedule semantics first, then split implementation into focused PRs.

options.title: Keep context inline only
options.body: Build only cron/result notifications and leave context pressure as the existing inline composer indicator with Compact action.

options.title: Defer to narrower issues
options.body: Leave this broad issue open as a meta tracker while narrower notification, inline-action, and cron-calendar issues advance independently.

recommendation.title: Scope focused core design
recommendation.body: Define the generic UI notification queue, cron-finished integration, and snooze/reschedule semantics first, then split implementation into focused PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and has recent cron notification routing history relevant to the backend event side.
